character.name: 军需小吏 / military quartermaster clerk
character.desc: Middle-aged Chinese man with neat short black beard and blue-grey folded clerk cap, dark indigo short official robe, cream collar, brown leather belt, small brass tally tokens, bamboo ledger held in left hand, short wooden tally baton in right, compact canvas supply satchel on hip. Tidy administrative silhouette, no herbs or basket.
character.special: marching order ward, open bamboo ledger, raise wooden tally baton high, point command and present brass order token
